content:
stage,status,detail
preparation,synthetic_reference_corrected,Initial float64 synthetic comparison used an implicit float32 one_hot target. Cast the reference target to logits dtype; strict loss/gradient checks then passed before any patient fit. Original failure retained.
science,fixed_budget_completed,15 new fixed supervised mixup models and 15 reused original references; no patient fit failures or automatic fit retries.
primary,STOP_FIXED_SUPERVISED_MIXUP,"All five initializations and all probability metrics retained; fixed prespecified decision, no alpha/layer/probability/epoch/seed extension."
inference,development_only,Current validation has cumulative development history; conditional intervals do not account for training/selection/research choices. Old final weights were not saved; only their existing curve metrics are reused.
publication,goal_summary_loop_corrected,Long goal-card action text triggered the existing reader observer to repeatedly shorten/regenerate its paragraph on overview. Shortened only that card action; full results retained in report. Native uncapped browser check then passed all eight routes. Science was not repeated.
